"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/existence-of-a-substring-in-a-string-and-its-reverse/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

3083. Existence of a Substring in a String and Its Reverse

Given a string s, find any substring of length 2 which is also present in the reverse of s.

Return true if such a substring exists, and false otherwise.

Example 1:

Input: s = "leetcode"
Output: true
Explanation: Substring "ee" is of length 2 which is also present in reverse(s) == "edocteel".

Example 2:

Input: s = "abcba"
Output: true
Explanation: All of the substrings of length 2 "ab", "bc", "cb", "ba" are also present in reverse(s) == "abcba".

Example 3:

Input: s = "abcd"
Output: false
Explanation: There is no substring of length 2 in s, which is also present in the reverse of s.

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 100
    s consists only of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def isSubstringPresent(self, s: str) -> bool:
        rev = s[::-1]
        seen = set()
        for i in range(len(rev) - 1):
            seen.add(rev[i : i + 2])
        for i in range(len(s) - 1):
            if s[i : i + 2] in seen:
                return True
        return False


sol = Solution()

print(sol.isSubstringPresent("leetcode"))  # true

assert sol.isSubstringPresent("leetcode") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abcba") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abcd") == False

assert sol.isSubstringPresent("a") == False
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("aa") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("ab") == False
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abba") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abcddcba") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("zzzzzzzzzz") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") == False
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("aabbccddeeffgghhiijj") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("abccbaabccba") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("xyyx") == True
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm") == False
assert sol.isSubstringPresent("a" * 100) == True
